dispositions.method: The 310 matched families first printed in 1776 that reach 4 or more newspapers were split into 1,219 single printed items by work/story_items.py (each printing's opening, looked for on all 2,319 pages of 1776 in both transcriptions). The 188 items printed in 7 or more newspapers (101 distinct documents or reports) were read; 28 were admitted as 22 stories, and phrase searches (phrase_patterns.json) confirmed their printings.
dispositions.selection_rule: Every single item printed in 9 or more newspapers was admitted, except digests of unrelated paragraphs. Items in 7 or 8 newspapers were chosen to cover the months from January to November and the main kinds of news: congressional and colonial documents, British documents, war reports and letters. One item a paper printed again later counts as a separate printing.
